scope.summary: Add cloud-ci target-parity admission so every Rust workspace member has a tracked BUCK file and members with Rust test code declare a rust_test target.
explicit_non_claims: No production branch protection, external infrastructure, or credentials are changed.
No generated JSON face is hand-edited; generated faces are materialized only by infra/ci/materialize-cloud-ci-generated-faces.sh.
The existing unwired rust_test debt is not remediated wholesale; it is frozen as mechanically-derived baseline debt.

facets.F1_correctness: The pure target-parity evaluator emits member_missing_buck and member_test_code_without_rust_test_target findings from producer rows keyed by workspace member path.
facets.F2_tests: TDD red was observed for the empty evaluator and for the missing target-parity producer face before implementing the evaluator and producer wiring.
facets.F3_maintainability: The concern is isolated to one gate crate, one producer face, one config registration path, and one ADR/catalog entry.
facets.F4_compatibility: Existing gates keep their faces and violation codes; target-parity is additive and registered through the same producer-face abstraction.
facets.F5_security: No credentials, network calls, unsafe Rust, or production service privileges are introduced; production Rust forbids unsafe code.
facets.F6_privacy: The gate reads repository metadata and Rust source text only; no tenant, user, or personal data processing changes.
facets.F7_operability: Remediation text points contributors to declare a rust_test target in the member BUCK file and verify it with buck2 test.
facets.F8_performance: The producer uses tracked-path facts and direct file reads over workspace members; no Cargo invocation or network call is required in the gate.
facets.F9_compliance: Generated faces remain generator-owned, the workflow matrix is updated, and ADR-0540 records the CI governance decision.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert of the additive gate, producer face registration, generated materialization, docs, and config.
facets.F11_observability: The live-corpus gate test prints member count and per-code debt counts, and firewall fixtures prove GREEN baselined debt plus RED new/frozen-empty debt.
facets.F13_migration: Moves Rust test coverage toward Buck2 merge authority without blocking unrelated work on the current 634-key unwired-test baseline.
